item.title: RoboPay wins the peaq track at Crypto World’s Fair
item.description: RoboPay took first place in the peaq track of the Crypto World’s Fair Hackathon by Colosseum. FieldProof, Fiducia, SKIM and DeSC followed in places two to five.
